description: Deploy autonomous AI agents in Seychelles. Automate luxury hospitality, maritime charters, and offshore business 24/7 on dedicated cloud computers.
h1: Powering Seychellois Enterprise with 24/7 Cloud AI
sub: Equip your business with autonomous bots running isolated cloud computers. From Mahé resort operations to international corporate administration, your agents work uninterrupted.
audience: Luxury resort managers, yacht charter fleets, maritime shipping agents, offshore corporate administrators, and island logistics coordinators across Mahé, Praslin, and La Digue.
manifesto: Operating across scattered archipelagos and global financial time zones demands continuous focus; Ceyo delivers persistent cloud intelligence that coordinates bookings, international compliance, and daily operations even when your phone is turned off.

uses.d: Automate guest inquiries, private transfer schedules, and catamaran excursion bookings across Mahé and Praslin resorts via Telegram.
Monitor marine weather bulletins, berth reservations at Eden Island Marina, and provisioning checklists autonomously around the clock.
Run automated compliance document checks, verify registry filings, and prepare client summaries for Victoria-based international business firms.
Track cargo consignments, ferry freight manifests, and island transfer schedules between Port Victoria, Baie Ste Anne, and La Passe.
Compile cold-chain transit logs, customs clearance certificates, and international invoices for Indian Ocean tuna processing shipments.
Aggregate solar microgrid metrics, rainwater telemetry, and conservation fund reporting into automated weekly Notion summaries.

steps.d: Select your agent roles, establish shared memory documents, and connect your essential business apps in minutes.
Assign autonomous web research, scheduling tasks, and interactive Telegram group chats for cross-agent collaboration.
Your agents execute tasks continuously inside dedicated cloud computers, keeping workflows moving even when you are offline.

chapters.d: Your marine operations bot fetches updated sea condition forecasts and reconciles charter itineraries around Sainte Anne Marine National Park. Passenger manifests are synced directly to Google Sheets before the crew steps aboard.

While you consult with clients in Victoria, your coding bot builds a secure document verification script in its cloud sandbox. It inspects statutory registers and flags missing compliance forms automatically.

Resort bots collaborate in a shared Telegram group to coordinate helicopter transfers between Mahé and private island villas. Client preferences and dietary needs are pushed directly into the central CRM.
As the islands sleep, your research bot tracks international financial regulatory changes across European and Asian markets. A structured executive briefing is compiled into Notion before sunrise.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a card is linked upon registration and charged only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do my bots continue working when my device loses connectivity?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer 24/7. Even if your phone is switched off, traveling between islands, or disconnected from the network, your agents continue browsing, coding, and processing tasks.

faq.q: Can I interact with my Ceyo agents through Telegram?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can connect agents to personal Telegram bots or invite multiple bots into Telegram group chats where they collaborate alongside your team as specialized coworkers.

faq.q: What languages do Ceyo agents support?
faq.a: Ceyo natively handles English, French, Seychellois Creole (Seselwa), and dozens of other international languages for text analysis, document translation, autonomous web browsing, and voice conversations.

faq.q: What tools can my agents operate autonomously?
faq.a: Your agents can navigate the web using their built-in browser, write and test software in a cloud shell, execute financial routines via an integrated crypto wallet, and connect to over 1,000 services like Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, and Notion.
